content:
Ben Carter: Dropping latest edits for regulated landing pages + final approval checklist. Goal: lock copy today so Design can ship + ENG can wire forms.

Ben Carter: Links:
- FinServ copy (Drive): https://drive.google.com/redwood/abm-finserv-landing-copy?tab=final
- Healthcare copy (Drive): https://drive.google.com/redwood/abm-healthcare-landing-copy?tab=final
- Figma preview: https://figma.com/file/redwood/reg-workloads-landing?node-id=431-220
- Preview build: https://preview.redwoodinference.com/regulated/finserv and /regulated/healthcare

Ben Carter: Checklist (need :white_check_mark: replies):
1) @Soojin Lee PMM: messaging + claims ok (FinServ + Healthcare)
2) @Dr. Aisha Rahman + @Olga Petrov: security/GRC wording ok (retention/residency/audit logs/KMS)
3) @Sofia Mendes: legal ok (no “HIPAA compliant” / no unsupported SLA language)
4) @Tyler Benson: tracking + form routing ok (UTMs, HubSpot fields, Slack notify)
5) @Markus Klein: SE sanity check on Private/VPC talk track vs reality

Soojin Lee: Reviewed both docs. Big things:
- Please keep “SOC 2 Type II report available under NDA” exactly as-is (no “certified” phrasing).
- On FinServ hero, we should avoid “guaranteed low latency” and instead say “predictable latency targets with Dedicated/Private capacity.”
I left comments in Drive.

Ben Carter: +1. I already swapped “guaranteed” -> “predictable” in the preview build. Will push the same to the Drive version now.

Camila Reyes: Skimmed the preview. Looks strong. One nit: CTA button currently says “Book a security review.” Can we change to “Schedule a security + architecture review”?
Reason: we want Platform Eng to feel included, not just CISO.

Ethan Wallace: I can tweak the subhead under CTA too:
Current: “Get answers on SOC 2, retention, and audit logs.”
Proposed: “Review SOC 2 posture, data boundaries, and a Private/VPC reference architecture.”

Ben Carter: Love that. Will update.

Dr. Aisha Rahman: Security review notes:
- Please avoid “zero data retention” anywhere. Use the approved phrasing: “Retention controls vary by deployment; Private keeps logs and data flows within your environment. Hosted/Dedicated retention is configurable for operational purposes.”
- “Customer-managed keys” is OK; “HSM” needs to be framed as “integrations available via customer KMS/HSM-backed keys” (don’t imply we run the HSM).
- Add one sentence clarifying: “Redwood does not use customer prompts/outputs to train models.” (approved statement)
(reactions: :thumbsup: x2)

Olga Petrov: +1 to Aisha. Also, for Healthcare page, remove “BAA available by default.” It should be “BAA available for eligible customers as part of enterprise agreements.”
I added a comment on the Healthcare section “Compliance & Contracts.”

Ben Carter: Got it. Updating Healthcare copy:
- Replace “BAA available by default” -> “BAA available for eligible customers (enterprise).”
- Replace “zero retention” mention in FAQ accordion -> retention controls by deployment.

Sofia Mendes: Legal pass:
- Please remove “HIPAA compliant” from the Healthcare page body copy. Safer: “Support for HIPAA-regulated workflows” + “BAA available for eligible customers.”
- Don’t say “data residency guaranteed.” Use “region selection options” / “data residency options by region and deployment.”
- Avoid “meets all regulatory requirements” (too broad). Maybe “designed to support common regulatory controls (logging, access control, encryption, auditability).”
Once those edits land, I’m good.

Ben Carter: Copy changes queued. I’ll reply here when preview updates.

Tyler Benson: Tracking/forms:
- UTMs: good, but we need `utm_campaign=abm_regulated_{vertical}` (finserv/healthcare) and preserve `utm_source`/`utm_medium`.
- Form should write to HubSpot fields: `ABM Vertical`, `Deployment Interest` (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), and `Security Review Requested` boolean.
- Slack notifications: route to #sales-intake-regulated + tag on-call SDR.
I’ll validate once the build updates.

Markus Klein: SE sanity check: mostly accurate.
Two small tweaks:
- “On-prem” should be “on-prem (limited availability)” unless we want to open that can of worms.
- In the architecture block, make sure we say “VPC peering / PrivateLink depending on cloud” not just “PrivateLink.”

Kevin Osei: Jumping in on the security FAQ accordion copy (since it’s mirrored from the addendum):
- “Audit logs exported to your SIEM” is ok if we say “export to customer-managed storage/SIEM” and don’t name Splunk unless we’re sure.
- “RBAC/SSO” should be “SSO (SAML/OIDC) + RBAC” (and no mention of SCIM unless it’s GA).

Ben Carter: Update: preview build refreshed with edits:
- Healthcare: removed “HIPAA compliant,” added “support for HIPAA-regulated workflows,” BAA phrasing fixed.
- FinServ: removed “guaranteed,” added “predictable latency targets with Dedicated/Private capacity.”
- Retention/residency wording updated per Security/GRC.
- On-prem now “limited availability.”
- Architecture block: “VPC peering / PrivateLink depending on cloud.”
Preview links unchanged.

Soojin Lee: PMM sign-off :white_check_mark: (with current preview). Thanks for cleaning up the claims.

Dr. Aisha Rahman: Security sign-off :white_check_mark: for the landing pages as shown in preview. Please keep the retention sentence exactly as it is if there are further edits.

Olga Petrov: GRC sign-off :white_check_mark: once the BAA line stays as edited and we don’t reintroduce “HIPAA compliant.”

Sofia Mendes: Legal sign-off :white_check_mark: on the latest preview.

Tyler Benson: Tracking sign-off pending a quick test submission. I’ll run one now and confirm fields/Slack routing.

Ben Carter: Perfect. Once Tyler confirms, I’ll post in #marketing-ops and tag Design + ENG that copy is locked.
